snippet.title: Ooble Gardens | Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist and play the demo now on Steam! - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3949790/Ooble_Gardens/

🍀✨ Step into Ooble Gardens, a cozy world where you play as an Ooble gardener, tending to a giant garden pot in a quiet backyard. Care for the playful Oobles by crafting their dream fairy garden. Using the offerings they give you, merge and combine to discover an endless variety of cozy furniture to decorate the garden with!

Follow us on our Socials! 
Website - https://www.novagames.com.au/
Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/novagames_au
